title: Amir Zuccolo will be the next mayor of Charlottetown as incumbent Philip Brown concedes
summary: Incumbent Philip Brown has conceded the Charlottetown mayoral race to Amir Zuccolo.

image.caption: Amir Zuccolo will succeed Philip Brown as the next mayor of Charlottetown after winning Monday's election. (Aaron Adetuyi/CBC)

blocks.text: Incumbent Philip Brown has conceded the Charlottetown mayoral race to Amir Zuccolo.
Packed mayoral race saw field of 7 candidates
A total of seven candidates were in the running for mayor. Zuccolo leads the pack with more than 4,500 votes as of 9 p.m. That's about 1,500 more votes than Brown.
Zuccolo succeeds Brown, who was first elected as mayor in 2018 and won two consecutive elections.
She will be the second woman to lead the capital city as mayor. Dorothy Corrigan held the position from 1969 to 1972.
Three of the city's 10 positions on council were acclaimed, while the remaining seven wards are still waiting for votes to be counted.
Gwyneth Egan is a reporter with CBC Prince Edward Island. She has a master's degree in journalism from Carleton University. You can reach her at gwyneth.egan1@cbc.ca
